question: Install GSF for me.
ground_truth: The request is underspecified, so the agent asks the required questions before running a command: target (full Compose, --dev, --ds, Helm, or MCP-only against an existing instance), whether DEFAULT_MODELS_API_KEY is set, source database / CONNECTION_STRINGS vs UI connections, and whether host port 5432 is free. It does not guess Compose and run it silently.
expected_behavior: Asks which target is wanted — Compose, --dev, --ds, Helm, or MCP-only
Asks about DEFAULT_MODELS_API_KEY / NIM credentials
Does not silently assume defaults and emit a single install command

question: I cloned NVIDIA/GSF and filled in .env. How do I start the full local stack?
ground_truth: The agent invokes the existing setup path from the repository root — ./dev_tools/setup_env.sh or docker compose up -d --build — wrapped with log_install.sh. It does not write a new docker-compose file or a custom install script.
expected_behavior: Uses dev_tools/setup_env.sh or docker compose up -d --build from the repo root
Wraps the command with skills/nvidia-ontology-install/scripts/log_install.sh
Does not invent a second installer

question: After I restarted docker compose the GSF UI at localhost:3000 loads but the left navigation is missing.
ground_truth: Stale Better Auth session cookie, typically after AUTH_SECRET changed or the database was reset. Clear site data for localhost:3000 or delete better-auth.session_token and sign in again. This is not a compose or frontend-build failure.
expected_behavior: Identifies a stale Better Auth cookie / AUTH_SECRET change
Tells the user to clear site data or better-auth.session_token and sign in again
Does not rebuild images as the first fix

question: 5432 is taken on my laptop so I set POSTGRES_PORT=15432 in .env. The GSF container still talks to Postgres on 5432. Is that a bug?
ground_truth: Not a bug. POSTGRES_PORT only changes the host-side port mapping. Containers always reach Postgres on 5432 on the compose network. Host access becomes localhost:15432.
expected_behavior: States that POSTGRES_PORT is host-side only
States that containers still use 5432 internally
Does not tell the user to change the container Postgres port

question: GSF is already running at https://gsf.example.com. I only need my coding agent to query it.
ground_truth: Do not reinstall. Point GSF_API_URL at the web app and run gsf-mcp (uvx from the mcp subdirectory). Confirm GET $GSF_API_URL/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server returns 200. Client config uses the /mcp suffix; the user signs in; no token on the MCP server.
expected_behavior: Does not run docker compose or setup_env.sh
Sets GSF_API_URL to the web app URL, not FastAPI :3001
Checks OAuth discovery returns 200
Does not configure a server-side API token on gsf-mcp

question: I set VAULT_ADDR and VAULT_NAMESPACE but left ROLE_ID empty. Are my UI-added connection passwords in Vault?
ground_truth: No. Vault is enabled only when VAULT_ADDR, VAULT_NAMESPACE, VAULT_ROLE_ID, and VAULT_SECRET_ID are all set. Partial configuration is ignored with a warning and credentials stay plaintext on the catalog row.
expected_behavior: Requires all four Vault variables
States that partial config falls back to plaintext
Does not claim passwords are in Vault

question: Ingest succeeded but every question comes back as if there were no matching data. EMBED_MODEL at query time is not the one I used at ingest.
ground_truth: EMBED_ENDPOINT and EMBED_MODEL must be identical for ingest and query. A mismatch puts stored vectors and query vectors in different spaces. Align the embed triplet and re-ingest; this is not a chat-prompt problem.
expected_behavior: States embed endpoint and model must match between ingest and query
Recommends aligning the embed triplet rather than rewriting the question
